title: Fee Reversals Posted since the Statement Closed: Effect on the Crestline Credit Card Desk Minimum
content:
For the minimum the Crestline care desk takes on the latest Crestline Credit Card statement, a fee reversal posted since the statement closed is reflected according to the fee it reverses: when it reverses the late fee posted in the statement's cycle, the reversed amount is taken off and so is the product's percentage of it, rounded up to the cent; when it reverses another fee posted on or before the statement's closing date, the reversed amount is taken off the past-due amount, never more than that amount; otherwise nothing is taken off for reversals. This is figured for an account on which at most one fee reversal has posted since the statement closed.

The late fee posted in the statement's cycle is the most recent late fee, when it was posted on or before the statement's closing date and charged for the statement that closed immediately before it, no more than 31 days earlier. The past-due amount is the minimum of the statement that late fee was charged for, less the payments made toward it and not returned, never less than zero; it is zero when no late fee was posted in the cycle.

| Product | Percentage |
|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 3.5% |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 3.25% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 3% |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 2.75% |

## Decision table

| Fee reversal on the card ledger, posted after the closing date | Taken off |
|---|---|
| reversing the late fee posted in the statement's cycle | the reversed amount plus the percentage of it, rounded up to the cent |
| reversing another fee posted on or before the closing date | the reversed amount, up to the past-due amount |
| reversing a fee posted after the closing date | nothing |
| none since the closing date | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical, 3.5% product)

- A 29.00 USD reversal of the cycle's late fee: 29.00 USD plus 1.02 USD (3.5 percent of 29.00 is 1.015, rounded up), 30.02 USD in all.
- A 30.00 USD reversal of a returned payment fee posted before the closing date, with a past-due amount of 18.00 USD: 18.00 USD is taken off.
- The same reversal with a past-due amount of 55.00 USD: 30.00 USD is taken off.
